lines.text: Know swim? Know how to swim!
Many learners say: I know to swim.
Better: I know how to swim.
How to! I know how to swim.

native.tip: En español “sé nadar”, pero en inglés falta “how”: “I know how to swim.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I know to swim.” Falta una palabra: “know how to” + verbo. “I know how to swim.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “how to”. Para decir que sabes hacer algo: “know how to” + verbo. Escribe una frase tuya con “how to” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “sé nadar”, but English adds “how”: “know how to swim.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “I know to swim.” One word is missing: “know how to” + verb. “I know how to swim.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
